messages:
Priya Nair: Starting Lumenix onboarding thread. Goals: verify SSO (SAML), ingest demo dataset into private staging, perf baseline for search/answer flows, and two admin enablement sessions. Please confirm owners and any immediate blockers.

Omar Haddad: I can own data ingest and schema mapping. Need sample export + preferred transfer (SFTP vs presigned S3). Also what retention/pseudonymization do they require?

Lila Kim: I'll take runtime + infra. Quick Q: expected peak QPS? If >50 sustained we'll plan dedicated pool. Also need their top 10 prompts.

Jason Wu: Enablement owner. I'll prepare two 20-min sessions (admin + ops) and one one-pager. Will record and share.

Priya Nair: Draft success criteria: 1) SAML test users can login to staging, 2) 2k+ demo rows ingested, 3) perf p95 <350ms for triage queries, 4) enablement recordings shared. If SAML delayed >5 business days mark renewal risk.

Omar Haddad: Ingest example (we prefer S3):
curl -X PUT "https://s3.amazonaws.com/lumenix-ingest-demo/sample.csv" -T sample.csv -H "x-amz-meta-client:lumenix"

acct-bot: private-staging deploy scheduled: lumenix-stack v1.4 -> Wed 02:00 UTC. Notify #eng-infra on failures.

Lila Kim: Once deploy is green I'll run a 500-request perf sweep Thu morning and post numbers.

Priya Nair: Owners recap: Omar (ingest/schema), Lila (runtime/perf), Jason (enablement). I'll add Lumenix PM to shared doc and schedule an initial sync Thu 9am PT. Post blockers here. :calendar:
